### [RxNorm](https://lynnhuangpeilin.shinyapps.io/RxNorm/)

A tool for working with RxNorm drug terminology — mapping and standardizing medication codes for pharmacoepidemiologic and health services research. Source code and documentation available on [GitHub](https://github.com/lynnhuang-peilin/RxNorm).
